tools.name: list_dailies
tools.description: List today's thirteen puzzles, their blurbs, and exact daily ids. No answers. Use open_daily to play one or the hub, and get_rules to explain a game without opening it.

tools.name: open_daily
tools.description: Open a playable daily, or the thirteen-puzzle hub when game is omitted or hub. Pass a game id to open that board; game defaults to hub. Progress stays in the widget and does not sync to the website. Do not reveal solutions. Use list_dailies to browse and get_rules to explain a game instead of openin

tools.name: get_rules
tools.description: Explain one game's rules and controls as titled steps, never a puzzle answer. Required game is a game id, not a board. Use this to teach a game. Use list_dailies to browse today's puzzles and open_daily to play.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "open_daily" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_dailies" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "List the thirteen daily puzzles, their descriptions, and exact daily identities. No puzzle answers. Use open_daily to play one or the hub, and get_rules to explain a game without opening it."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
